domain_restrictions: t is real and satisfies 0 <= t and t < 1
a equals floor(n*t) so a is an integer
since t < 1, n*t < n, hence a <= n-1
therefore a divided by n lies in the interval [0, 1)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1 and all real numbers t with 0 <= t < 1, let a be floor(n*t). Then E_n(t) is less than or equal to E_n(a divided by n).

variables.name: t
variables.role: input variable to the function E_n

witness_dependencies: a depends on n and t via the rule a = floor(n*t)

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with 0 <= t < 1, if a = floor(n*t), then E_n(t) <= E_n(a/n).
